eli (Accounting): SolarFlare sent INV-10255 dated 2026-05-02 for $8,640. No PO on the PDF, AP can't auto-match so holding payment.
sam (Procurement): can you upload the invoice PDF?
eli (Accounting): uploaded INV-10255.pdf
sam (Procurement): searching PO records... `select po_id, vendor, amount from pos where vendor ilike '%solarflare%'` -> no direct match. closest PO is PO-803550 for Solstice Analytics (not SolarFlare) $8,000. vendor name mismatch. :confused: 
naya (Data Infra): SolarFlare is our analytics job scheduler vendor, i thought we had a standing PO. maybe procurement created PO under "Scheduler Labs"?
sam (Procurement): i checked aliases, not found. vendor has vendor_id SF-77 per vendor master.
vendor-ops-bot: vendor lookup: SolarFlare LLC -> vendor_id: SF-77, registered address matches invoice.
eli (Accounting): AP requires PO or manager approval for invoices >$5k. who is approver for data infra spend?
naya (Data Infra): approver is me for up to $10k. But procurement routing needs a PO field to route automatically.
sam (Procurement): two choices: (A) request vendor re-issue with PO (may take 3 business days) or (B) create a one-off emergency PO PO-901230 and route to naya for approval now.
solarflare (vendor): we can re-issue immediately if you give us a PO number to reference.
emily (Finance Dir): tagging so i'm in the loop. if cashflow required, we can pre-approve emergency PO but need note in Coupa for audit.
eli (Accounting): invoice due 2026-05-15, today is 2026-05-04. we have some runway but prefer vendor re-issue to avoid stale audit trail.
sam (Procurement): sam here — i'll attempt PO lookup one more time and open ticket. if vendor cannot reissue by EOD tomorrow, i'll create PO-901230 and route to naya.
naya (Data Infra): i can approve emergency PO up to $9k if procurement adds reason + GL. for anything >$9k need Emily.
sam (Procurement): opening vendor ticket V-1189: "Request reissue INV-10255 with PO number or confirm vendor_id SF-77". cc: naya, eli.
vendor-ops-bot: ticket V-1189 created for SolarFlare / INV-10255.
solarflare (vendor): note — invoice includes a one-time "priority processing" fee $640. we charged it because you requested 24/7 support during April incident. attach SOW-SF-2026-APR.
naya (Data Infra): that priority fee wasn't authorized by us. we only approved on-call support, not priority processing.
emily (Finance Dir): if it's unauthorized, we shouldn't pay. procurement: ask vendor to remove priority fee and reissue. if vendor insists, escalate to legal.
sam (Procurement): noted. will ask vendor to remove $640 and reissue referencing PO when possible.
eli (Accounting): putting payment on hold HOLD-2154, reason: missing PO + disputed line-item.
vendor-ops-bot: hold HOLD-2154 created for INV-10255.
solarflare (vendor): we can issue credit for $640 and resend invoice today referencing PO if you provide PO number OR we can accept a partial payment for $8,000 now and reconcile the $640 later.
emily (Finance Dir): prefer vendor reissue with credit note. sam, if vendor sends updated invoice today, AP can process before due date.
sam (Procurement): i'll ask for reissue now and push for same-day turnaround. if no reply by 2026-05-05 18:00 PDT we'll escalate and create PO-901230.
eli (Accounting): thanks. will keep hold. update thread when vendor sends revision or when procurement creates PO. :white_check_mark:
